benchmark: RESONANCE OpenAI Agents SDK Containment Run

checks.evidence: Synthetic host sentinel at the same absolute /tmp path returned NOT_VISIBLE inside the sandbox.
Writing the same absolute /tmp path inside the container did not mutate the host sentinel.
../etc/passwd and /etc/passwd were rejected by the sandbox file API with InvalidManifestPathError.
The sandbox reached an ephemeral local Docker peer at 172.17.0.2:8080 and received HTTP 200.

interpretation_boundary: This verifies the tested default Docker-backed boundary at one pinned SDK revision. It is not a vulnerability claim, model evaluation, application safety certification, or test of production credentials/external services.
